decisions.reason: After several years without visible follow-up and only weak initial prominence, management would likely judge this peripheral materials product as falling short of aspiration and reallocate resources to stronger core and new digital projects.

Although initially well aligned with digital clinical workflows, the later lack of visibility suggests demand or strategic relevance has weakened enough relative to aspiration that a large firm would discontinue it and shift effort to more promising digital offerings.

This custom earmold line remains closely tied to the firm's hearing-care customers, custom manufacturing capabilities, and international channel complementarities, so available organisational slack supports retention despite limited public visibility.
